statement: Alternative advanced-packaging routes at Samsung (I-Cube/X-Cube) and Amkor OSAT are quoted at 26-39 week lead times, materially shorter than TSMC CoWoS at 52-78 weeks.
why: Shorter lead times at non-TSMC packaging houses give designers a faster, if less preferred, path to capacity, which is the main pressure valve on the packaging bottleneck.

impact.mechanism: Qualified alternative packaging capacity with shorter queues adds effective accelerator supply outside the constrained incumbent line.

evidence.excerpt: Samsung I-Cube/X-Cube and Amkor OSAT advanced packaging: "26-39 week lead times".

confidence.basis: Secondary analysis site estimate with no primary supplier confirmation and no volume figures.
